script.cover_1: Do you want to grow or not? Said to motivate.
script.payoff: It may sound like a threat, so the junior stops asking for anything.
script.caption: Motivation that sounds like a threat teaches silence. Send this to the lead who says it before every review.
script.sent: Do you want to grow or not?
script.lands: A junior who asks for more may hear a threat and stop asking for anything.
script.better: Let us sit down next week and list what you would like to learn.
script.why: It turns a challenge into a plan and gives the junior a date to expect.
